summary.text: Steven Swinton is the Libertarian Party candidate for North Carolina's 13th Congressional District, on the November 3, 2026 ballot after the Libertarian primary was canceled. He was the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina Senate District 19 in 2024, receiving 2,884 of 88,586 votes cast. Ballotpedia lists no education, occupation or other biographical details for him.
